Use when creating React applications, implementing server-side rendering, setting up monorepos with multiple packages, optimizing build performance and caching strategies, adding icon libraries, managing shared dependencies, or working with TypeScript full-stack projects. 4 license: MIT 5 version: 1.0.0 6 --- 7 8 # Web Frameworks Skill Group 9 10 Comprehensive guide for building modern full-stack web applications using Next.js, Turborepo, and RemixIcon. 11 12 ## Overview 13 14 This skill group combines three powerful tools for web development: 15 16 **Next.js** - React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features 17 **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript 18 **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons 19 20 ## When to Use This Skill Group 21 22 - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React 23 - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages 24 - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation 25 - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching 26 - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography 27 - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects 28 - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization 29 30 ## Stack Selection Guide 31 32 ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon 33 34 Use when building a standalone application: 35 - E-commerce sites 36 - Marketing websites 37 - SaaS applications 38 - Documentation sites 39 - Blogs and content platforms 40 41 **Setup:** 42 ```bash 43 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 44 cd my-app 45 npm install remixicon 46 ``` 47 48 ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon 49 50 Use when building multiple applications with shared code: 51 - Microfrontends 52 - Multi-tenant platforms 53 - Internal tools with shared component library 54 - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic 55 - Design system with documentation site 56 57 **Setup:** 58 ```bash 59 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 60 # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory 61 # Install remixicon in shared UI packages 62 ``` 63 64 ### Framework Features Comparison 65 66 | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | 67 |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| 68 | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | 69 | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | 70 | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | 71 | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | 72 73 ## Quick Start 74 75 ### Next.js Application 76 77 ```bash 78 # Create new project 79 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 80 cd my-app 81 82 # Install RemixIcon 83 npm install remixicon 84 85 # Import in layout 86 # app/layout.tsx 87 import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' 88 89 # Start development 90 npm run dev 91 ``` 92 93 ### Turborepo Monorepo 94 95 ```bash 96 # Create monorepo 97 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 98 cd my-monorepo 99 100 # Structure: 101 # apps/web/ - Next.js application 102 # apps/docs/ - Documentation site 103 # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon 104 # packages/config/ - Shared configs 105 # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration 106 107 # Run all apps 108 npm run dev 109 110 # Build all packages 111 npm run build 112 ``` 113 114 ### RemixIcon Integration 115 116 ```tsx 117 // Webfont (HTML/CSS) 118 119 120 121 // React component 122 import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" 123 124 125 ``` 126 127 ## Reference Navigation 128 129 **Next.js References:** 130 - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes 131 - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming 132 - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states 133 - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR 134 135 **Turborepo References:** 136 - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure 137 - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering 138 - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation 139 140 **RemixIcon References:** 141 - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility 142 143 ## Common Patterns & Workflows 144 145 ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo 146 147 ``` 148 my-monorepo/ 149 ├── apps/ 150 │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app 151 │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app 152 │ └── docs/ # Documentation site 153 ├── packages/ 154 │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon 155 │ ├── api-client/ # API client library 156 │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs 157 │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types 158 └── turbo.json # Build pipeline 159 ``` 160 161 **turbo.json:** 162 ```json 163 { 164 "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", 165 "pipeline": { 166 "build": { 167 "dependsOn": ["^build"], 168 "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] 169 }, 170 "dev": { 171 "cache": false, 172 "persistent": true 173 }, 174 "lint": {}, 175 "test": { 176 "dependsOn": ["build"] 177 } 178 } 179 } 180 ``` 181 182 ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library 183 184 ```tsx 185 // packages/ui/src/button.tsx 186 import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" 187 188 export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { 189 return ( 190 194 ) 195 } 196 197 // apps/web/app/page.tsx 198 import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" 199 import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" 200 201 export default function Page() { 202 return 203 } 204 ``` 205 206 ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching 207 208 ```tsx 209 // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx 210 import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' 211 212 // Static generation at build time 213 export async function generateStaticParams() { 214 const posts = await getPosts() 215 return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) 216 } 217 218 // Revalidate every hour 219 async function getPost(slug: string) { 220 const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { 221 next: { revalidate: 3600 } 222 }) 223 if (!res.ok) return null 224 return res.json() 225 } 226 227 export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { 228 const post = await getPost(params.slug) 229 if (!post) notFound() 230 231 return
{post.content}
232 } 233 ``` 234 235 ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline 236 237 ```yaml 238 # .github/workflows/ci.yml 239 name: CI 240 on: [push, pull_request] 241 242 jobs: 243 build: 244 runs-on: ubuntu-latest 245 steps: 246 - uses: actions/checkout@v4 247 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 248 with: 249 node-version: 18 250 - run: npm install 251 - run: npx turbo run build test lint 252 env: 253 TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} 254 TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} 255 ``` 256 257 ## Utility Scripts 258 259 Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: 260 261 **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices 262 **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo 263 264 Usage examples: 265 ```bash 266 # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup 267 python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router 268 269 # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run 270 python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run 271 272 # Run tests 273 cd scripts/tests 274 pytest 275 ``` 276 277 ## Best Practices 278 279 **Next.js:** 280 - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed 281 - Implement proper loading and error states 282 - Use Image component for automatic optimization 283 - Set proper metadata for SEO 284 - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) 285 286 **Turborepo:** 287 - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) 288 - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) 289 - Configure outputs for proper caching 290 - Enable remote caching for team collaboration 291 - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only 292 293 **RemixIcon:** 294 - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis 295 - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering 296 - Provide aria-labels for accessibility 297 - Use currentColor for flexible theming 298 - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons 299 300 ## Resources 301 302 - <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>MedBook — Find and Book Top Doctors Instantly</title>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    :root {
      --primary: #1B1464;
      --primary-light: #2d247a;
      --accent: #FFD930;
      --accent-hover: #e6c32b;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #F8F9FB;
      --gray-100: #F0F2F5;
      --gray-200: #E2E6EA;
      --gray-300: #C5CBD3;
      --gray-400: #9BA3AF;
      --gray-500: #6B7280;
      --gray-600: #4B5563;
      --gray-700: #374151;
      --gray-800: #1F2937;
      --teal: #0EA5A0;
      --teal-light: #E6F7F7;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .header.scrolled {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 64px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--primary);
      text-decoration: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .nav-desktop {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav-link {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-link:hover {
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--primary-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-accent {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .btn-accent:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--primary);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      background: rgba(27, 20, 100, 0.04);
    }

    .btn-lg {
      padding: 14px 32px;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .menu-toggle {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      font-size: 24px;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px;
    }

    /* Mobile Menu */
    .mobile-menu {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: -100%;
      width: 280px;
      height: 100vh;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 1100;
      padding: 80px 24px 24px;
      transition: right 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow: -4px 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    .mobile-menu.open {
      right: 0;
    }

    .mobile-menu-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 1050;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .mobile-menu-overlay.open {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .mobile-nav-link {
      display: block;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 14px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .mobile-nav-actions {
      margin-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-actions .btn {
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* Hero */

      padding: 140px 24px 80px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, #2d247a 50%, #1B1464 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -50%;
      right: -20%;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,217,48,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -30%;
      left: -10%;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(14,165,160,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);

      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .hero-title span {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 20px);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Search Bar */
    .search-container {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .search-bar {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .search-field {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 200px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .search-field-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    .search-field input,
    .search-field select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px 16px 16px 48px;
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      outline: none;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      appearance: none;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
    }

    .search-field input:focus,
    .search-field select:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .search-field input::placeholder {
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .search-field select {
      cursor: pointer;
      padding-right: 40px;
    }

    .search-field .select-arrow {
      position: absolute;
      right: 16px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 16px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .search-btn {
      padding: 16px 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* Autocomplete Dropdown */
    .autocomplete-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      max-height: 280px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      z-index: 100;
    }

    .autocomplete-dropdown.active {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .autocomplete-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-700);
    }

    .autocomplete-item:hover,
    .autocomplete-item.highlighted {
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .autocomplete-item i {
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .autocomplete-category {
      padding: 8px 16px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    /* Stats Bar */
    .stats-bar {
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      padding: 24px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .stats-inner {
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-around;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 140px;
    }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--primary);
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      margin-top: 4px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Sections */
    .section {
      padding: 80px 24px;
    }

    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 56px;
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--teal);
      background: var(--teal-light);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--primary);
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Specialties */
    .specialties-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .specialty-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 20px;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    .specialty-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .specialty-icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
      font-size: 28px;
      color: var(--primary);
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }

    .specialty-card:hover .specialty-icon {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .specialty-name {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .specialty-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* How It Works */
    .how-it-works {
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .steps-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .step-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 40px 32px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }

    .step-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .step-number {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
    }

    .step-icon {
      font-size: 40px;
      color: var(--primary);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    .step-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .step-desc {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .step-connector {
      display: none;
    }

    /* Testimonials */
    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .testimonial-stars {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .testimonial-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--teal));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-800);
    }

    .testimonial-location {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    /* Mobile App Promo */
    .app-promo {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, #2d247a 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .app-promo::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px;
      right: -100px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,217,48,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .app-promo-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .app-promo-content {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .app-promo-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(255,217,48,0.15);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .app-promo-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .app-promo-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .app-features {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .app-feature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
    }

    .app-feature i {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .app-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .app-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--primary);
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .app-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .app-btn i {
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .app-promo-visual {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .phone-mockup {
      width: 280px;
      height: 560px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 36px;
      padding: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      position: relative;
    }

    .phone-screen {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gray-50) 0%, var(--white) 100%);
      border-radius: 28px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .phone-notch {
      width: 100px;
      height: 24px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .phone-content {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .phone-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .phone-card-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--teal));
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .phone-card-info {
      flex: 1;
    }

    .phone-card-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-800);
    }

    .phone-card-subtitle {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .phone-card-badge {
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .footer {
      background: var(--gray-800);
      color: var(--gray-300);
      padding: 64px 24px 32px;
    }

    .footer-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.5fr repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-brand {
      max-width: 280px;
    }

    .footer-logo {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      text-decoration: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .footer-column-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-link {
      display: block;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 6px 0;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-link:hover {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-copyright {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 20px;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-social a:hover {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .steps-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .testimonials-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .app-promo-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .app-promo-visual {
        order: -1;
      }

      .app-features {
        align-items: center;
      }

      .app-buttons {
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-desktop {
        display: none;
      }

      .menu-toggle {
        display: block;
      }

      .hero {
        padding: 120px 20px 60px;
      }

      .search-bar {
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 12px;
      }

      .search-field {
        min-width: 100%;
      }

      .search-btn {
        width: 100%;
      }

      .stats-inner {
        gap: 16px;
      }

      .stat-value {
        font-size: 22px;
      }

      .section {
        padding: 60px 20px;
      }

      .specialties-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .specialty-card {
        padding: 24px 16px;
      }

      .steps-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .testimonials-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .phone-mockup {
        width: 220px;
        height: 440px;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 32px;
      }

      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .specialties-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Animations */
    @keyframes fadeInUp {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(20px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    .animate-in {
      animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease forwards;
    }

    .delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
    .delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.3s; }

    /* Scroll reveal */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(24px);
      transition: all 0.6s ease;
    }

    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  </style>
</head>

  <script>
    // Autocomplete data
    const searchSuggestions = {
      specialties: [
        'Primary Care',
        'Dentist',
        'Dermatologist',
        'Psychiatrist',
        'Eye Doctor',
        'Orthopedic Surgeon',
        'Cardiologist',

        'Dr. Sarah Chen',
        'Dr. Michael Ross',
        'Dr. Emily Park',
        'Dr. David Jones',
        'Dr. Lisa Wang',
        'Dr. James Miller'
      ]
    };

    // DOM elements
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
    const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
    const mobileMenuOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileMenuOverlay');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const autocompleteDropdown = document.getElementById('autocompleteDropdown');

    // Header scroll effect
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 10) {
        header.classList.add('scrolled');
      } else {
        header.classList.remove('scrolled');
      }
    });

    // Mobile menu toggle
    function openMobileMenu() {
      mobileMenu.classList.add('open');
      mobileMenuOverlay.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      menuToggle.innerHTML = '<i class="ri-close-line"></i>';
    }

    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
      mobileMenuOverlay.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      menuToggle.innerHTML = '<i class="ri-menu-line"></i>';
    }

    menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (mobileMenu.classList.contains('open')) {
        closeMobileMenu();
      } else {
        openMobileMenu();
      }
    });

    mobileMenuOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

    // Close mobile menu on link click
    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    });

    // Autocomplete
    let highlightedIndex = -1;

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
      const value = this.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (value.length < 1) {
        autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
        return;
      }

      const results = [];
      
      const specialtyMatches = searchSuggestions.specialties.filter(s => 
        s.toLowerCase().includes(value)
      );
      if (specialtyMatches.length) {
        results.push({ category: 'Specialties', items: specialtyMatches });
      }

      const conditionMatches = searchSuggestions.conditions.filter(c => 
        c.toLowerCase().includes(value)
      );
      if (conditionMatches.length) {
        results.push({ category: 'Conditions', items: conditionMatches });
      }

      const doctorMatches = searchSuggestions.doctors.filter(d => 
        d.toLowerCase().includes(value)
      );
      if (doctorMatches.length) {
        results.push({ category: 'Doctors', items: doctorMatches });
      }

      if (results.length === 0) {
        autocompleteDropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="autocomplete-item"><i class="ri-search-line"></i>No results found</div>';
        autocompleteDropdown.classList.add('active');
        return;
      }

      let html = '';
      results.forEach(group => {
        html += `<div class="autocomplete-category">${group.category}</div>`;
        group.items.forEach(item => {
          html += `<div class="autocomplete-item" data-value="${item}"><i class="ri-arrow-right-line"></i>${item}</div>`;
        });
      });

      autocompleteDropdown.innerHTML = html;
      autocompleteDropdown.classList.add('active');
      highlightedIndex = -1;

      // Add click handlers
      autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item[data-value]').forEach(item => {
        item.addEventListener('click', function() {
          searchInput.value = this.dataset.value;
          autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
        });
      });
    });

    // Keyboard navigation for autocomplete
    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      const items = autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item[data-value]');
      if (!items.length || !autocompleteDropdown.classList.contains('active')) return;

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        highlightedIndex = Math.min(highlightedIndex + 1, items.length - 1);
        updateHighlight(items);
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        highlightedIndex = Math.max(highlightedIndex - 1, 0);
        updateHighlight(items);
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && items[highlightedIndex]) {
          searchInput.value = items[highlightedIndex].dataset.value;
          autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
        }
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
      }
    });

    function updateHighlight(items) {
      items.forEach((item, i) => {
        item.classList.toggle('highlighted', i === highlightedIndex);
      });
      if (items[highlightedIndex]) {
        items[highlightedIndex].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
      }
    }

    // Close autocomplete on outside click
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!e.target.closest('.search-field')) {
        autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
      }
    });

    // Search form handler
    function handleSearch(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const query = searchInput.value.trim();
      const location = document.getElementById('locationInput').value.trim();
      const insurance = document.getElementById('insuranceSelect').value;
      
      if (!query) {
        searchInput.focus();
        searchInput.style.borderColor = '#ef4444';
        setTimeout(() => {
          searchInput.style.borderColor = '';
        }, 2000);
        return;
      }

      // Simulate search navigation
      alert(`Searching for "${query}"${location ? ' in ' + location : ''}${insurance ? ' with ' + insurance : ''}...`);
    }

    // Specialty filter handler
    function filterSpecialty(specialty) {
      searchInput.value = specialty;
      document.getElementById('searchForm').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      setTimeout(() => searchInput.focus(), 500);
    }

    // Scroll reveal
    const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

    // Smooth scroll for anchor links
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const href = this.getAttribute('href');
        if (href === '#') return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = document.querySelector(href);
        if (target) {
          const headerOffset = 80;
          const elementPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          const offsetPosition = elementPosition + window.pageYOffset - headerOffset;
          window.scrollTo({ top: offsetPosition, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
